_comment: Copy into a workspace directory as config.json (outside any git checkout) and fill in real values. Secrets never live here: credentials are named by env var, not stored. 'schedule' is declarative only; launchd/cron owns the clock.

source._comment: visibility is 'public' (default), 'private' or 'all'; archived repos are always skipped. since 'state' starts the window at last_run in <workspace>/state/github-releases.json (agent run injects state_dir), or at first_run_since when there is no state yet; any ISO date instead of 'state' is used literally and leaves the state file alone (hand re-runs). max_commit_age_days skips a release whose tagged commit is older than the window start minus that many days (a backfilled old tag), logging each skip to stderr. exclude_repos: forks and mirrors whose releases are not ours to announce.

destination.title: Release notes
destination.prompt: Write this week's release notes from the releases below. Group by repo, keep each project's own wording where it is good, and skip version bumps with no user-visible change.
